# The Ninth Lock Opens Inward

## Source

A bargeman at [[Riverfold]], who would not give a name.

## The Rumor (Verbatim)

That the ninth lock opens inward, and that it has not been worked in living memory.
The bargeman claimed to have it from [[The Fifth Keeper]].

## Key Elements

- The ninth gate is not merely disused
- Somebody knows why

## What This Rumor Suggests

That [[Nine Locks]] has a ninth gate at all is not in dispute; what is above it is.

## Quest Implications

Would give [[Errand - Find the Ledger Keeper]] somewhere to go.

## Related

- [[Nine Locks]]
- [[The Ninth Lock]]

## Player Notes

[[Marisol Quay]] changed the subject when asked.

## Notes

Unverified, and the only source is anonymous.
